description: Receipts bound to the workspace tree (plan task pod-18, docs/PROOF-RECEIPTS.md) in lib/agent-progress.mjs: the tree key, fresh / stale / unknown, the receipts kept and their bounds, the four projections, the progress of an older version, the current tree after a call (its trees, a scanned call without trees, a call that never ran), a new run and its start tree, the count of checks that changed the files, and what the model is told; judged by tests/verify-agent-progress.mjs.

mutations.name: AP-key-any-algorithm
mutations.what: two tree algorithms give the same key

mutations.name: AP-unknown-own-tree
mutations.what: a receipt without a tree is judged stale, not unknown

mutations.name: AP-stale-is-fresh
mutations.what: a receipt of another tree is fresh

mutations.name: AP-receipt-tree-raw
mutations.what: a tree that is not a tree key is kept

mutations.name: AP-unbounded
mutations.what: every receipt of a kind is kept

mutations.name: AP-bound-25
mutations.what: 25 receipts of a kind are kept

mutations.name: AP-old-lists-keep-tree
mutations.what: the lists of an older version keep a tree written in them

mutations.name: AP-old-lists-dropped
mutations.what: the receipts of an older version are lost

mutations.name: AP-project-unknown
mutations.what: a receipt of unknown freshness is projected as verified

patches.old: progress[bucket] = progress.receipts.filter((item) => item.kind === kind && receiptFreshness(item, progress.tree) === FRESHNESS.fresh);
patches.new: progress[bucket] = progress.receipts.filter((item) => item.kind === kind && receiptFreshness(item, progress.tree) !== FRESHNESS.stale);

mutations.name: AP-summary-tree-known
mutations.what: the summary says the tree is known when it is not

patches.old: const summary = { tree: current !== null, fresh: 0, stale: 0, unknown: 0 };
patches.new: const summary = { tree: true, fresh: 0, stale: 0, unknown: 0 };

mutations.name: AP-newrun-keeps-tree
mutations.what: a new run keeps the tree of the run before

mutations.name: AP-saved-tree-dropped
mutations.what: a reload forgets the current tree

mutations.name: AP-observe-tree-keeps
mutations.what: a start tree that failed leaves the tree known

mutations.name: AP-proof-ignored
mutations.what: a call's trees do not move the current tree

mutations.name: AP-proof-after-failed-keeps
mutations.what: a call whose snapshot after failed leaves the tree known

mutations.name: AP-unscanned-unknown
mutations.what: a read without trees makes the tree unknown

mutations.name: AP-not-run-unknown
mutations.what: a call that never ran makes the tree unknown

mutations.name: AP-checks-changed-any
mutations.what: an edit that changed the tree is counted as a check that changed it

patches.old: if (category === 'verifying' && before !== null && after !== null && before !== after) progress.checksChangedTree += 1;
patches.new: if (before !== null && after !== null && before !== after) progress.checksChangedTree += 1;

mutations.name: AP-checks-changed-never
mutations.what: a check that changed the tree is not counted

mutations.name: AP-checks-changed-not-saved
mutations.what: the count of checks that changed the files is not saved

mutations.name: AP-more-own-tree
mutations.what: the other files of a batch are not bound to its tree

mutations.name: AP-no-dedupe
mutations.what: the same receipt observed again is kept twice

mutations.name: AP-no-project-after-call
mutations.what: the projections are not made again after a call

mutations.name: AP-checkpoint-counts
mutations.what: the model is told the stale count as the fresh one

patches.old: 'Host receipts by the workspace tree they were made on: fresh on the latest tree: ' + summary.fresh
patches.new: 'Host receipts by the workspace tree they were made on: fresh on the latest tree: ' + summary.stale
